Each fuel type is written to its own tab in the shared sheet (e.g. "Fuel Log - 100LL" and "Fuel Log - JETA1").

Tank Calibration

Editing calibration for: 100LL — use the tank switch in the header above to change which tank you're editing.

Dip height (cm)Volume (L)

Enter dip-stick height and known volume pairs from the tank's manufacturer calibration chart (at least 2 points). Volume for any dip reading is interpolated between the nearest points.

—

Pump Counter Calibration

The Before/After readings on the fueling form are a pump meter that counts up forever and never resets on its own. If the pump is physically replaced or its counter is reset, set the new starting number here — otherwise the app will think a fueling of many thousand liters just happened.

No fuelings logged yet for this tank.

Tank Level Reading

Record the tank's current level — from the dip calculator above, or directly from a delivery slip — so the app can estimate how much is left as fuel is dispensed. Add a short note for refills (e.g. supplier, invoice number) to keep an audit trail.

Dispensed Counter

The "Total Dispensed" figure on the main tank gauge can be zeroed for a new reporting period (e.g. monthly). This never touches the actual logged history in the Sheet — only what the counter displays from that point on.

System Access

Anyone with the QR code below gets in automatically — no typing. Anyone without it is asked for this passkey instead. Changing the passkey here updates it for everyone immediately, and invalidates any QR codes printed with the old one.

Shown at the bottom of the printed tank sign, in case someone needs to reach a person about the system.

Data Backup & Reset

Download every logged fueling and tank reading as an Excel file, then optionally clear the log data from the shared Sheet once you've confirmed the backup is safe. This never touches your settings — tank calibration, the aircraft list, and the passkey are always kept.

Note: connection settings, tank calibration, the aircraft list, and the ledger are shared data — visible to anyone else using this app.

Export & Backup Data

This downloads every logged fueling and tank reading (both tanks) as a single Excel file. Your settings — tank calibration, the aircraft list, and the passkey — are never included and never cleared by this.

Clearing data is permanent. Only do this after you've opened the downloaded file and confirmed it has everything you expect.

Type CLEAR below to confirm. This removes every row from the Fuel Log and Tank Readings tabs — settings are untouched.
